content.text:
**fail**

### Visible evidence that matches

| Requirement | Visible in this frame |
|---|---|
| Cream canvas | Light cream full-screen background |
| Species-confidence placeholder | Label **SPECIES CONFIDENCE**; placeholder **Rank 1 · waiting for still** |
| Chip rail placeholder | Horizontal chips **Cap** / **Gill** / **Pore** (Gill selected, sky) |
| Shoot / Import CTAs | Side-by-side **Shoot** (sky) and **Import** (cream/russet border) |
| Bottom coach bar | Placeholder **Ask habitat / lookalike...** + mic + waveform controls |
| Palette russet / cream / sky | Title/disclaimer/accents russet; canvas cream; Shoot/active chip/mic sky |
| Disclaimer | Exact text **非可食认证 / not an edibility certification** |
| No bottle-rail / field-card / mosaic / clapper / sky-arc / table-zone / sprocket chrome | None of those chrome types visible |
| No competitor names | None visible |
| No safe-to-eat claim | No such claim; disclaimer states the opposite |

Also visible (not forbidden by the standard): **SporeCue** title, settings gear, banner **AI not configured — local capture still works.**

### Why overall = fail

**Oversized empty gill/pore bar** — not visible as a distinct oversized empty bar. Gill/Pore appear only as chips on the chip rail; that rail is already counted under “chip rail placeholder” and does not satisfy a separate oversized gill/pore bar.

### Uncertain (cannot judge from this image alone)

- Whether the single **Rank 1 · waiting for still** row fully counts as a **vertical stack** (only one rank row is visible; no multi-row stack is shown).
- Whether any off-screen / scrolled content exists — not checkable from this single crop.

**Bottom line:** Required empty-home chrome mostly matches, but the required **oversized empty gill/pore bar** is missing in what is visible → **fail**.
